name: Pebble Hiroo Terrace
short_description: California-inspired all-day brunch in Hiroo, pairing pancakes, burritos, fried chicken, and seasonal plates with an open, pet-friendly terrace.

name: TenCups Cafe Bar & Lounge
short_description: A plant-filled Shibuya café and cocktail lounge serving Northern Thai coffee, Southeast Asian-inspired food, and inventive evening drinks.

name: d'ici
short_description: A Hiroo French bistro focused on regional French cooking, buckwheat galettes, customizable courses, and a broad French wine selection.

name: KANPAI KAMATA
short_description: A Kamata neighborhood spot for Indian and Nepali curries, tandoori dishes, naan, biryani, and spice-forward drinking food.

name: BBQ DAYS Kichijoji Parco
short_description: Seasonal rooftop BBQ at Kichijoji PARCO with charcoal grills, bring-your-own food and drinks, prepared sets, and beer-garden-style group dining.

name: Bistro 961
short_description: A compact Tsukishima bistro pairing handmade creative dishes with Japanese wine and craft gin, from pasta and seasonal plates to meat dishes.

name: Bar Mokuren
short_description: A compact Hatagaya bar pairing Scotch-led whisky and classic or seasonal cocktails with handmade Italian- and French-influenced dishes and desserts.

name: Kameido Art Center
short_description: Artist-run alternative gallery in Kameido combining rotating exhibitions with a cafe stand, silkscreen printing, workshops, talks, and art goods.

name: Sumibi Yakitori Shin
short_description: A compact Iidabashi yakitori restaurant with charcoal-grilled skewers, seasonal vegetable dishes, Japanese sake, and counter or table seating.

name: HOWL DELI Ariake Urban Sports Park
short_description: Pet-friendly Ariake deli cafe serving over-rice bowls, salads, sandwiches, drinks, and dedicated dog-friendly dishes in a spacious sports-park setting.

name: Qiqihar Barbecue
short_description: Qiqihar-style Northeastern Chinese barbecue in Takenotsuka, serving seasoned meats with fermented cabbage and regional Chinese dishes in a lively neighborhood setting.

name: de’Afrique (De Afrique)
short_description: An Ethiopian-led African restaurant-bar in Okusawa serving injera, dorowat, couscous, and other regional dishes with African drinks.

name: Shunju
short_description: A discreet Minami-Aoyama Chinese restaurant serving seasonal Shanghai home-style cuisine through a reservation-only omakase course.

name: Lounge 8 Tokyo
short_description: A compact Shibuya bar focused on Japanese whisky, craft gin, and other Japanese-made drinks, with casual small plates and cocktails.

name: Trattoria Shunraku
short_description: A seven-seat counter trattoria serving casual Italian cooking with Japanese-influenced flavors in a quiet Higashi-Nakano setting.

name: hal okada vegan patisserie
short_description: Hiroo’s specialist vegan patisserie, offering 100% plant-based cakes, seasonal sweets, and custom celebration cakes for advance pickup.

name: Zururi Yanaka Sohonten
short_description: A small Yanaka ramen izakaya serving light soy ramen and rich chicken-pork paitan, with counter seats and tatami tables.

name: Local Spicy SITARA Tsukiji
short_description: A casual Indian restaurant near Tsukiji Station serving curry, naan, biryani, tandoori dishes, and other South Asian fare in a neighborhood setting.

name: Shunpu Taitou
short_description: A small Soshigaya bistro pairing comforting European-style dishes with natural wine, plus an intimate in-house wine shop.

name: Kin Sushi
short_description: Long-running Jimbocho sushi counter serving seasonal Edomae sushi, house-seasoned rice, and traditional kanpyo rolls in a small setting.

name: Janata Mart Halal Food
short_description: A halal food shop in Nakarokugo specializing in Indian and Nepali spices and related South Asian food products.

name: Pizza House Taguchi
short_description: Neighborhood pizza shop in Nishiarai, Tokyo, near Nishiarai-Daishi-Nishi Station, offering handmade pizzas for local diners.

name: VinIX (Vank)
short_description: A private-room dinner pairing aged black Wagyu yakiniku with French techniques, detailed presentation, and a bank-themed dining experience.

name: Sushi Masa
short_description: An omakase sushi counter in Toyosu Senkyaku Banrai, serving seasonal fish and creative dishes with the chef working in front of guests.

name: Yuima
short_description: Small evening Chinese restaurant near Iogi Station, serving familiar dishes, dumplings, Sichuan-style items, and Chinese drinks.
